messages.subject: RE: Calderwell CV-7 - recall reference R/2025/118
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

Thank you for the notification. We acknowledge it and have allocated recall reference R/2025/118, to be quoted on all correspondence and customer communications.

We are content this proceeds as a manufacturer-led voluntary recall. Please revise the action plan to (1) raise the 12-month completion target from 85% to at least 90% with escalation steps for non-responders, (2) bring Phase 1 safety guidance forward to within 10 days, (3) confirm OTA is prioritised to connected vehicles, and (4) provide the VIN schedule and confirm reporting at 3, 6 and 12 months. Revised plan within 14 days please.

K. Whitlow, HM Inspector, Vehicle Safety Branch, DVSA

messages.subject: FW: Calderwell CV-7 - recall reference R/2025/118
messages.plaintextBody:
All - DVSA have allocated recall reference R/2025/118 and are content for us to proceed. They want four changes to the plan: completion target up to 90% (from 85%) with escalation for non-responders, Phase 1 guidance within 10 days, OTA prioritised, and a VIN schedule plus 3/6/12-month reporting. We'll turn the revised plan around well within their 14 days. Raj - can you pull the VIN schedule?

Tom

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
